# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.0 Worker 1 Slot 84: Dynamic Epidemics, Venetian Double-Island Lazarettos, Habsburg Pestkordon & Wu Youxing Wenyi Lun (oe_dis_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_dynamic_diseases.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Early Modern Levantine Recurrent Plague (1460-1750, Rule #15 gated)
# Models post-Black Death Mediterranean, Venetian, Ottoman, Marseille, and East Asian trade-port recurrences.
oe_dis_levantine_plague = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					oe_dis_rule_is_off = yes
					current_year < 1460
					current_year > 1750
					disease_is_active = scope:disease
					NOT = {
						situation:black_death = {
							situation_has_ended = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			value = 0
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_dis_rule_is_mild = yes }
			value = 0.005
		}
		else = {
			value = 0.012
		}
	}

	spawn = {
		random_list = {
			70 = {
				random_ownable_location = {
					limit = {
						population > 5
						is_coastal = yes
						"disease_resistance(scope:disease)" < 0.5
						OR = {
							region = region:italy_region
							region = region:balkan_region
							region = region:anatolia_region
							region = region:egypt_region
							region = region:crescent_region
							region = region:france_region
						}
					}
					spawn_disease = {
						disease = scope:disease
						value = 1
						save_scope_as = outbreak
					}
				}
			}
			30 = {
				random_ownable_location = {
					limit = {
						population > 5
						is_coastal = yes
						"disease_resistance(scope:disease)" < 0.5
						oe_dis_is_levantine_plague_port = yes
					}
					spawn_disease = {
						disease = scope:disease
						value = 1
						save_scope_as = outbreak
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	r0 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					topography = mountains
					topography = wetlands
					vegetation = desert
					vegetation = jungle
					climate = arctic
					location_rank ?= location_rank:rural_settlement
				}
			}
			value = { 1.0 1.25 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				location_rank ?= location_rank:town
			}
			value = { 1.25 1.55 }
		}
		else = {
			value = { 1.45 1.85 }
		}

		# Markets and maritime entrepots accelerate human-to-human transmission.
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = market_village
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = marketplace
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = slave_market
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = entrepot
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = trading_hub
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = stock_exchange
				}
			}
			multiply = 1.2
		}

		# Venetian Double-Island Lazarettos sharply dampen port R0 (x0.55; both islands x0.75 further).
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_dis_lazzaretto_vecchio
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_dis_lazzaretto_nuovo
				}
			}
			multiply = 0.55
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_dis_lazzaretto_vecchio
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_dis_lazzaretto_nuovo
				}
				multiply = 0.75
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = lazaretto
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = hospital
				}
			}
			multiply = 0.85
		}

		# Stagnation and accumulated immunity slow R0.
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					disease_has_stagnated = scope:disease
					"disease_resistance(scope:disease)" > 0.5
				}
			}
			subtract = { 0.2 0.65 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					disease_presence = {
						disease = scope:disease
						value <= 0.2
					}
				}
				subtract = 0.3
			}
		}
	}

	calc_interval_days = 24

	location_stagnation_chance = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				location_rank ?= location_rank:rural_settlement
			}
			value = 0.09
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				location_rank ?= location_rank:town
			}
			value = 0.05
		}
		else = {
			value = 0.03
			if = {
				limit = {
					location_population_percentage < 0.1
				}
				add = 0.10
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					topography = mountains
					topography = wetlands
					vegetation = desert
					vegetation = jungle
					climate = arctic
				}
			}
			add = 0.20
		}

		# Double-Island Lazarettos raise local stagnation chance (+0.25).
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_dis_lazzaretto_vecchio
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_dis_lazzaretto_nuovo
				}
			}
			add = 0.25
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				"disease_resistance(scope:disease)" > 0.5
			}
			add = {
				value = "disease_resistance(scope:disease)"
				subtract = 0.5
				multiply = 0.30
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				"disease_resistance(scope:disease)" > 0.95
			}
			add = 0.10
		}
	}

	percentage_to_meet_their_fate_on_calc = {
		value = 0.22
	}

	mortality_rate = { 0.14 0.30 }

	monthly_resistance_reduction = 0.003

	location_modifier = {
		local_forced_attrition = 4
		max_attrition = 8
		local_pop_promotion_speed_modifier = -1.2
		local_pop_demotion_speed_modifier = 0.4
		local_prosperity_decay = 0.07
		local_monthly_control = -0.002
		local_monthly_development = -0.008
		local_migration_attraction = -3.5
		local_migration_speed = 0.04
	}

	character_mortality_chance = {
		value = 0.05
		multiply = "disease_presence(scope:disease)"
	}

	location_spread_threshold = {
		value = 0.25
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_dis_lazzaretto_nuovo
			}
			multiply = 1.5
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				num_roads = 0
				OR = {
					topography = mountains
					vegetation = desert
					vegetation = jungle
				}
			}
			multiply = 1.6
		}
	}

	on_spread_to_country = {
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.1
	}

	map_color = {
		lerp = {
			min_color = rgb { 220 140 70 }
			max_color = rgb { 135 28 24 }
			factor = "disease_presence(scope:disease)"
		}
	}

	secondary_map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				disease_affects_pops_here = scope:disease
			}
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_TOP
		}
	}
}

# 2. Early Modern Camp Fever & Liqi Pestilence (1485-1750, Rule #15 gated)
# Models Thirty Years War camp typhus, Chongzhen-era Liqi pestilence, and Eurasian siege fevers.
oe_dis_camp_fever = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					oe_dis_rule_is_off = yes
					current_year < 1485
					current_year > 1750
					disease_is_active = scope:disease
				}
			}
			value = 0
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_dis_rule_is_mild = yes }
			value = 0.006
		}
		else = {
			value = 0.014
		}
	}

	spawn = {
		random_ownable_location = {
			limit = {
				population > 3
				"disease_resistance(scope:disease)" < 0.5
				OR = {
					continent = continent:europe
					continent = continent:asia
					sub_continent = sub_continent:north_africa
				}
				OR = {
					prosperity < 0.05
					has_siege = yes
					AND = {
						has_owner = yes
						owner = { at_war = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			spawn_disease = {
				disease = scope:disease
				value = 0.75
				save_scope_as = outbreak
			}
		}
	}

	r0 = {
		value = { 0.85 1.25 }

		# War devastation and low prosperity amplify camp fever spread (x1.8).
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					prosperity < 0
					is_looted = yes
					has_siege = yes
				}
			}
			multiply = 1.8
		}

		# Frontier Pestkordon stations and v10.0 Ever-Normal Granaries suppress transmission (x0.6).
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_dis_pestkordon_station
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_econ2_ever_normal_granary
				}
			}
			multiply = 0.6
		}

		multiply = {
			value = "disease_presence(scope:disease)"
			multiply = 1.2
			add = 1
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					disease_has_stagnated = scope:disease
					"disease_resistance(scope:disease)" > 0.5
				}
			}
			subtract = { 0.2 0.55 }
		}
	}

	calc_interval_days = { 16 24 }

	location_stagnation_chance = {
		value = 0.06
		if = {
			limit = { prosperity >= 0.25 }
			add = 0.12
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_dis_pestkordon_station
					has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_econ2_ever_normal_granary
				}
			}
			add = 0.22
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				"disease_resistance(scope:disease)" > 0.5
			}
			add = {
				value = "disease_resistance(scope:disease)"
				subtract = 0.45
				multiply = 0.30
			}
		}
	}

	# Army marching contagion slows down as camp presence falls.
	sub_unit_stagnation_chance = {
		value = 0.45
		subtract = {
			value = "disease_presence(scope:disease)"
			multiply = 0.4
		}
	}

	percentage_to_meet_their_fate_on_calc = {
		value = 0.24
	}

	mortality_rate = { 0.08 0.22 }

	monthly_resistance_reduction = 0.003

	location_modifier = {
		local_forced_attrition = 5
		max_attrition = 9
		local_pop_promotion_speed_modifier = -0.9
		local_prosperity_decay = 0.06
		local_monthly_control = -0.002
		local_migration_attraction = -2.5
	}

	# High character lethality tests court seclusion, Asclepius sanctuaries, and Wenyi Lun medicine.
	character_mortality_chance = {
		value = 0.09
		multiply = "disease_presence(scope:disease)"
	}

	location_spread_threshold = {
		value = 0.22
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_dis_pestkordon_station
			}
			multiply = 1.6
		}
	}

	on_spread_to_country = {
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.2
	}

	map_color = {
		lerp = {
			min_color = rgb { 196 184 96 }
			max_color = rgb { 98 42 108 }
			factor = "disease_presence(scope:disease)"
		}
	}

	secondary_map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				disease_affects_pops_here = scope:disease
			}
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_TOP
		}
	}
}
